name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)

eligibility.other_conditions: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Loans categorized into Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 Lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 to 10 Lakh).

benefits: Collateral-free business loans up to Rs 10 Lakhs (and up to Rs 20 Lakhs under Tarun Plus) at competitive interest rates with no processing fees for Shishu.
documents_required: Quotation of machinery or items to be purchased
application_process: Apply online via Udyami Mitra portal or visit any commercial bank, RRB, or NBFC.
Submit MUDRA loan application form with business proposal.
Bank conducts field inspection and disburses approved loan amount.
